subject: The EP-WXT trigger 01709271197 is likely a flaring star
editedBy: Judith Racusin at NASA/GSFC <judith.racusin@nasa.gov> on behalf of EP Team at NAOC/CAS <ep_ta@bao.ac.cn>
body:
Y.H. Jiang (NJU), Q.Y. WU, W. D. Zhang (NAO, CAS) on behalf of the Einstein Probe (EP) team: 

The EP-WXT trigger 01709271197 at the time of 2026-06-20T05:24:06, is likely a stellar flare associated with 2MASS J18430597-4058047. The estimated flux of the flare is around 1.0 x 10 ^(-10) erg/s/cm^2 in 0.5-4.0 keV, corresponding to an X-ray luminosity of around 4.1 x 10^(31) erg/s. 

Launched on January 9, 2024, EP is a space X-ray observatory to monitor the soft X-ray sky with X-ray follow-up capability (Yuan et al. 2022, Handbook of X-ray and Gamma-ray Astrophysics).
